name: auto-research
description: Can you see what the AI did, and is it still your research? A stage-aware research operating system: durable .research-os project state, capability probing with explicit degradation, first-class blockers, gate loop-backs, autonomous loop, template-first figure routing with a versioned figure library, two-stage visual contracts, and an anti-amnesia index (versions, ammo depot, snapshots), plus a research map (what changed, what it stands on, where it trips your taste rules) and a sourced taste ledger. Entry point: /auto-research:pilot.
